description: Evaluates whether the skill prompt produces test-first development behavior

criteria.description: Must write test cases BEFORE writing implementation code
Must identify and test edge cases (empty inputs, null, boundaries)
Must test failure scenarios and error handling
Test assertions must be specific (not just 'toBeTruthy')
Must mention or consider test coverage for critical paths
Must NOT write implementation before tests are defined

testPrompt: I need to build a function that validates a client onboarding form. It takes an object with firstName, lastName, email, phone, dateOfBirth, and fitnessGoal. It should return { valid: boolean, errors: string[] }. Build this using TDD.
